name: Voorbeeldstad Digital Twin
description: The Voorbeeldstad Digital Twin is a municipal digital twin platform for a fictitious Dutch city, combining a CityGML 3D model of buildings with live feeds from telecom antennas, traffic sensors and district heating meters, and offering a web viewer and a scenario engine for planning studies. It is operated by the Gemeente Voorbeeldstad, the municipality, with a systems integrator, to support urban planning and incident management. Coverage is the city and its 180,000 buildings; sensor feeds are updated every five minutes and the 3D model yearly. The viewer is public on the web, the 3D model is downloadable as CityGML and CityJSON under CC-BY-4.0, while the scenario engine and the live feeds require an institutional account. There is no cost for the open parts. Caveats: the building model has level of detail 2 only, sensor coverage is uneven across districts, and documentation is in Dutch. Interfaces are a web GUI and an OGC SensorThings API; deployment is cloud. Simulation uses include digital twin, hazard exposure and climate adaptation. It was found through a procurement notice and is not yet linked to any other catalogued record.
